risk_if_not_implemented: Without Permitted Monitoring Actions, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Content of Event Logs
compensating_control_1.justification: Content of Event Logs (MON-09) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Permitted Actions (MON-29) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Protection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to protect event logs, security-relevant telemetry and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification and deletion.
